title: Time-to-first-answer benchmark from a clean install
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Measure install to first useful mission answer on a clean HOME with a mock model download and fail on regressions past a budget. Integration test zc_time_to_answer.rs.
